items.difficulty_reason: The displayed equality is quoted from Modules on Sites; the work is verifying the directed-colimit hypothesis (2)(c) of the sites remark for X_fppf with the affine basis: quasi-compactness gives the smooth affine cover, fppf coverings refine to finite affine ones, and the fibre-product sheaf is quasi-compact by quasi-separatedness so an affine surjective etale cover exists. The final statement uses colimit commutation of the inclusion and qc of finitely presented modules.
